reserveReview.rationale: The USD1 proof-of-reserves adapter exposes one aggregate U.S. Treasury Bills, Money Market Funds & Cash slice, retained as the exact source-native row. Note B of the KPMG-examined July 31, 2026 report records $1,101,473,492 in demand-deposit cash and cash equivalents and $2,899,393,738 in government money-market fund shares (CUSIP 31607A703), totaling $4,000,867,230. The underlying split is 27.53% deposits and 72.47% government money-market fund, but those dated percentages are not presented as live adapter constituents. The separate BitGo Bank & Trust account balance is zero.
